newsitem.title: USA: Twin-engine plane crashes in Texas, four dead.
newsitem.headline: Twin-engine plane crashes in Texas, four dead.

text.p: Four people were killed on Tuesday when a twin-engine plane crashed near Alice, Texas, about 40 miles west of Corpus Christi, officials said.
"We have four fatalities," U.S. Federal Aviation Administration spokesman John Clabes said.
The Beechcraft Queen Air crashed after taking off from a regional airport in Alice, an investigator with the U.S. National Transportation Safety Board in San Antonio said.
NTSB investigators were heading to the scene of the crash, she said.
Officials were uncertain where the plane was headed and who was on board.
"We don't know if it's a commercial or a private aircraft, or an air taxi," Clabes said.
